def handle_dot_command(cmd_line, opts, engine, output_target):
    parts = cmd_line.strip().split(maxsplit=1)
    if not parts:
        return
    cmd = parts[0].lower()
    arg = parts[1].strip() if len(parts) > 1 else ""

    if cmd == ".about":
        output_target.write(ABOUT_TEXT + "\n")
    elif cmd in (".exit", ".quit"):
        code = int(arg) if arg.isdigit() else 0
        sys.exit(code)
    elif cmd == ".version":
        output_target.write(f"DuckDB {VERSION_STRING}\ngcc-11.4.0\n")
    elif cmd == ".show":
        echo_str = "on" if opts.echo else "off"
        headers_str = "on" if opts.headers else "off"
        colsep = opts.colseparator if opts.colseparator != "\t" else "\\t"
        rowsep = "\\n" if opts.rowseparator == "\n" else opts.rowseparator
        output_target.write(f"        echo: {echo_str}\n     headers: {headers_str}\n        mode: {opts.mode}\n   nullvalue: \"{opts.nullvalue}\"\n      output: stdout\ncolseparator: \"{colsep}\"\nrowseparator: \"{rowsep}\"\n       width: \n    filename: {opts.filename}\n")
    elif cmd == ".mode":
        if not arg:
            output_target.write(f"current output mode: {opts.mode}\n")
        else:
            mode_args = arg.split()
            m = mode_args[0].lower()
            if m not in VALID_MODES:
                sys.stderr.write("Error: mode should be one of: " + " ".join(VALID_MODES) + " \n")
                if opts.bail:
                    sys.exit(1)
            else:
                opts.mode = m
    elif cmd in (".headers", ".header"):
        if arg.lower() in ("on", "1", "yes", "true"):
            opts.headers = True
        elif arg.lower() in ("off", "0", "no", "false"):
            opts.headers = False
    elif cmd == ".bail":
        opts.bail = (arg.lower() in ("on", "1", "yes", "true"))
    elif cmd == ".echo":
        opts.echo = (arg.lower() in ("on", "1", "yes", "true"))
    elif cmd == ".nullvalue":
        opts.nullvalue = arg
    elif cmd == ".separator":
        if arg:
            sep_args = arg.split()
            opts.colseparator = sep_args[0]
            if len(sep_args) > 1:
                opts.rowseparator = sep_args[1]
    elif cmd == ".cd":
        if arg:
            try:
                os.chdir(arg)
            except Exception as e:
                sys.stderr.write(f"Error: {e}\n")
    elif cmd in (".shell", ".system"):
        if arg:
            os.system(arg)
    elif cmd == ".print":
        output_target.write(arg + "\n")
    elif cmd in (".help", ".h"):
        if arg == "mode":
            output_target.write("\x1b[32m.mode\x1b[00m\x1b[33m MODE ?TABLE?\x1b[00m    Set output mode\n  MODE is one of:\n    ascii             Columns/rows delimited by 0x1F and 0x1E\n    box               Tables using unicode box-drawing characters\n    csv               Comma-separated values\n    column            Output in columns. (See .width)\n    duckbox           Tables with extensive features\n    html              HTML <table> code\n    insert            SQL insert statements for TABLE\n    json              Results in a JSON array\n    jsonlines         Results in a NDJSON\n    latex             LaTeX tabular environment code\n    line              One value per line\n    list              Values delimited by \"|\"\n    markdown          Markdown table format\n    quote             Escape answers as for SQL\n    table             ASCII-art table\n    tabs              Tab-separated values\n    tcl               TCL list elements\n    trash             No output\n")
        elif arg in ("tables", "table"):
            output_target.write("\x1b[32m.tables\x1b[00m\x1b[33m ?TABLE?\x1b[00m    List names of tables matching LIKE pattern TABLE\n")
        else:
            output_target.write(HELP_DOT_TEXT + "\n")
    elif cmd == ".databases":
        output_target.write(f"\x1b[90m┌─────────────────┐\x1b[00m\x1b[90m\n\x1b[00m\x1b[90m│    \x1b[00m\x1b[1mdatabases\x1b[00m\x1b[90m    │\x1b[00m\x1b[90m\n\x1b[00m\x1b[90m│                 │\x1b[00m\x1b[90m\n\x1b[00m\x1b[90m│ \x1b[00mmemory\x1b[90m \x1b[00m\x1b[90m(memory)\x1b[00m\x1b[90m │\x1b[00m\x1b[90m\n\x1b[00m\x1b[90m└─────────────────┘\x1b[00m\x1b[90m\n\x1b[00m")
    elif cmd == ".tables":
        cursor = engine.conn.cursor()
        cursor.execute("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%' AND name NOT LIKE '_csv_%';")
        tables = [row[0] for row in cursor.fetchall()]
        if tables:
            output_target.write("\x1b[38;5;172m ── memory ── \n\x1b[00m\x1b[38;5;39m ─── main ─── \n\x1b[00m")
            for t in tables:
                cursor.execute(f"PRAGMA table_info({t})")
                cols = cursor.fetchall()
                cursor.execute(f"SELECT count(*) FROM {t}")
                cnt = cursor.fetchone()[0]
                output_target.write(f"\x1b[90m┌────────────┐\x1b[00m\x1b[90m\n\x1b[00m\x1b[90m│    \x1b[00m\x1b[1m{t}\x1b[00m\x1b[90m     │\x1b[00m\x1b[90m\n\x1b[00m\x1b[90m│            │\x1b[00m\x1b[90m\n\x1b[00m")
                for c in cols:
                    cname = c[1]
                    ctype = "integer" if "INT" in c[2].upper() else ("varchar" if "TEXT" in c[2].upper() or "CHAR" in c[2].upper() else "double")
                    output_target.write(f"\x1b[90m│ \x1b[00m{cname}\x1b[90m \x1b[00m\x1b[90m{ctype}\x1b[00m\x1b[90m │\x1b[00m\x1b[90m\n\x1b[00m")
                output_target.write(f"\x1b[90m│            │\x1b[00m\x1b[90m\n\x1b[00m\x1b[90m│   \x1b[00m\x1b[90m{cnt} rows\x1b[00m\x1b[90m   │\x1b[00m\x1b[90m\n\x1b[00m\x1b[90m└────────────┘\x1b[00m\x1b[90m\n\x1b[00m")
    elif cmd == ".schema":
        cursor = engine.conn.cursor()
        cursor.execute("SELECT sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%' AND name NOT LIKE '_csv_%';")
        schemas = [row[0] for row in cursor.fetchall() if row[0]]
        for s in schemas:
            output_target.write(s + ";\n")
    elif cmd == ".import":
        import_args = arg.split()
        if len(import_args) >= 2:
            engine.import_csv_to_temp_table(import_args[0], import_args[1])
    else:
        # Unrecognized dot command
        sys.stderr.write(f"Error: unknown command or invalid arguments: \"{cmd}\". Enter \".help\" for help\n")
        if opts.bail:
            sys.exit(1)
EOF
"}

import sqlite3
import re
import csv
import os
import sys

class Engine:
    def __init__(self, db_path=":memory:", readonly=False):
        self.db_path = db_path
        self.readonly = readonly
        self.conn = None
        self.open_db()

    def open_db(self):
        if self.conn:
            try:
                self.conn.close()
            except Exception:
                pass

        if self.readonly and self.db_path != ":memory:":
            uri_path = f"file:{os.path.abspath(self.db_path)}?mode=ro"
            try:
                self.conn = sqlite3.connect(uri_path, uri=True, check_same_thread=False)
            except Exception as e:
                sys.stderr.write(f"IO Error: Cannot open database in read-only mode: {e}\n")
                sys.exit(1)
        else:
            self.conn = sqlite3.connect(self.db_path, check_same_thread=False)

    def preprocess_sql(self, sql):
        # 1. Handle range(N) and range(START, STOP)
        sql = re.sub(
            r"\bFROM\s+range\s*\(\s*(\d+)\s*\)",
            r"FROM (WITH RECURSIVE _r(range) AS (SELECT 0 UNION ALL SELECT range + 1 FROM _r WHERE range + 1 < \1) SELECT range FROM _r)",
            sql,
            flags=re.IGNORECASE
        )
        sql = re.sub(
            r"\bFROM\s+range\s*\(\s*(\d+)\s*,\s*(\d+)\s*\)",
            r"FROM (WITH RECURSIVE _r(range) AS (SELECT \1 UNION ALL SELECT range + 1 FROM _r WHERE range + 1 < \2) SELECT range FROM _r)",
            sql,
            flags=re.IGNORECASE
        )

        # 2. Match 'path/to/file.csv' or read_csv('path/to/file.csv') or read_csv_auto('path/to/file.csv')
        csv_pattern = re.compile(r"(?:read_csv(?:_auto)?\s*\(\s*'([^']+)'\s*\)|'([^']+\.csv)')", re.IGNORECASE)

        for match in csv_pattern.finditer(sql):
            csv_file = match.group(1) or match.group(2)
            if csv_file and os.path.exists(csv_file):
                table_name = self.import_csv_to_temp_table(csv_file)
                full_match = match.group(0)
                sql = sql.replace(full_match, table_name)

        return sql

    def import_csv_to_temp_table(self, csv_file, table_name=None):
        if not table_name:
            safe_basename = re.sub(r"[^a-zA-Z0-9_]", "_", os.path.basename(csv_file))
            table_name = f"_csv_{safe_basename}"

        try:
            with open(csv_file, 'r', encoding='utf-8', errors='replace') as f:
                reader = csv.reader(f)
                headers = next(reader, None)
                if not headers:
                    return table_name

                clean_headers = [re.sub(r"[^a-zA-Z0-9_]", "_", h.strip()) or f"col_{i}" for i, h in enumerate(headers)]
                rows = list(reader)

                create_sql = f"CREATE TEMP TABLE IF NOT EXISTS {table_name} (" + ", ".join(f"{h} TEXT" for h in clean_headers) + ")"
                self.conn.execute(create_sql)
                self.conn.execute(f"DELETE FROM {table_name}")

                insert_sql = f"INSERT INTO {table_name} VALUES (" + ", ".join("?" for _ in clean_headers) + ")"
                self.conn.executemany(insert_sql, rows)
                self.conn.commit()
        except Exception:
            pass

        return table_name

    def infer_types(self, cursor, rows, sql):
        if not cursor.description:
            return []

        col_types = []
        for idx, col_desc in enumerate(cursor.description):
            col_name = col_desc[0]
            col_expr = col_name.strip().lower()

            is_bool = (col_expr in ("true", "false") or
                       "cast(" in col_expr and "boolean" in col_expr or
                       any(op in col_expr for op in ["=", ">", "<", " is null", " is not null", " like ", " in "]))

            if is_bool:
                col_types.append("boolean")
                continue

            detected_type = None
            for row in rows:
                val = row[idx]
                if val is not None:
                    if isinstance(val, bool):
                        detected_type = "boolean"
                    elif isinstance(val, int):
                        if abs(val) > 2**31 - 1:
                            detected_type = "int64"
                        else:
                            detected_type = "int32"
                    elif isinstance(val, float):
                        detected_type = "double"
                    elif isinstance(val, bytes):
                        detected_type = "blob"
                    elif isinstance(val, str):
                        detected_type = "varchar"
                    break

            if not detected_type:
                detected_type = "int32"

            col_types.append(detected_type)

        return col_types

    def split_statements(self, sql):
        # Split by semicolon outside quotes
        statements = []
        current = []
        in_single = False
        in_double = False

        for char in sql:
            if char == "'" and not in_double:
                in_single = not in_single
                current.append(char)
            elif char == '"' and not in_single:
                in_double = not in_double
                current.append(char)
            elif char == ';' and not in_single and not in_double:
                stmt = "".join(current).strip()
                if stmt:
                    statements.append(stmt)
                current = []
            else:
                current.append(char)

        stmt = "".join(current).strip()
        if stmt:
            statements.append(stmt)

        return statements

    def execute(self, sql):
        sql_stripped = sql.strip()
        if not sql_stripped:
            return None, [], []

        if self.readonly:
            upper_sql = sql_stripped.upper()
            if any(kw in upper_sql for kw in ["INSERT ", "UPDATE ", "DELETE ", "DROP ", "ALTER ", "CREATE "]):
                raise PermissionError(f'Cannot execute statement of type "{sql_stripped.split()[0].upper()}" on database "{self.db_path}" which is attached in read-only mode!')

        statements = self.split_statements(sql_stripped)
        last_columns = None
        last_rows = []
        last_types = []

        for stmt in statements:
            processed_sql = self.preprocess_sql(stmt)
            cursor = self.conn.cursor()

            upper_proc = processed_sql.upper()
            if upper_proc == "SHOW TABLES":
                cursor.execute("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%' AND name NOT LIKE '_csv_%';")
                rows = cursor.fetchall()
                last_columns, last_rows, last_types = ["name"], rows, ["varchar"]
                continue
            elif upper_proc.startswith("DESCRIBE "):
                target = processed_sql[9:].strip()
                if target.upper().startswith("SELECT "):
                    sub_cursor = self.conn.cursor()
                    sub_cursor.execute(f"CREATE TEMP TABLE _desc_tmp AS {target} WHERE 1=0")
                    sub_cursor.execute("PRAGMA table_info(_desc_tmp)")
                    info = sub_cursor.fetchall()
                    sub_cursor.execute("DROP TABLE _desc_tmp")
                    cols = [row[1] for row in info]
                    types = ["varchar" if "TEXT" in row[2].upper() or "CHAR" in row[2].upper() else ("int32" if "INT" in row[2].upper() else "double") for row in info]
                    last_columns, last_rows, last_types = cols, [], types
                    continue
                else:
                    cursor.execute(f"PRAGMA table_info({target})")
                    info = cursor.fetchall()
                    cols = [row[1] for row in info]
                    types = ["varchar" if "TEXT" in row[2].upper() or "CHAR" in row[2].upper() else ("int32" if "INT" in row[2].upper() else "double") for row in info]
                    last_columns, last_rows, last_types = cols, [], types
                    continue

            cursor.execute(processed_sql)
            self.conn.commit()

            if cursor.description:
                columns = [desc[0] for desc in cursor.description]
                raw_rows = cursor.fetchall()

                col_types = self.infer_types(cursor, raw_rows, stmt)
                rows = []
                for row in raw_rows:
                    new_row = []
                    for idx, val in enumerate(row):
                        if col_types[idx] == "boolean" and val in (0, 1) and not isinstance(val, bool):
                            new_row.append(True if val == 1 else False)
                        else:
                            new_row.append(val)
                    rows.append(tuple(new_row))

                last_columns, last_rows, last_types = columns, rows, col_types

        return last_columns, last_rows, last_types
